title: Artinian lifting criterion for smoothness of a finite type algebra at a prime
statement:
Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $\varphi_0:R\to A$ be a ring homomorphism making $A$ a finitely generated $R$-algebra, and let $\mathfrak q\subset A$ be a prime ideal; write $\pi=\operatorname{Spec}\varphi_0:\operatorname{Spec}A\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. A *small extension* is a surjective ring homomorphism $\varphi:B'\to B$ of Artinian local rings whose kernel has length $1$ as a $B'$-module; $\mathfrak m_B$ denotes the maximal ideal of $B$. The following are equivalent:

(1) there is an open subset $W\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}A$ with $\mathfrak q\in W$ such that $\pi|_W:W\to\operatorname{Spec}R$, with $W$ the open subscheme of $\operatorname{Spec}A$ on this set, is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms];

(2) for every small extension $\varphi:B'\to B$, every ring homomorphism $\rho:R\to B'$ and every ring homomorphism $a:A\to B$ with $a\circ\varphi_0=\varphi\circ\rho$ and $a^{-1}(\mathfrak m_B)=\mathfrak q$, there is a ring homomorphism $a':A\to B'$ with $\varphi\circ a'=a$ and $a'\circ\varphi_0=\rho$.

(This is Stacks Algebra, Lemma 02HT, (1)$\Leftrightarrow$(3). There (1) reads "$R\to A$ is smooth at $\mathfrak q$", Algebra Definition 00TB: some $g\in A\setminus\mathfrak q$ has $R\to A_g$ a smooth ring map. This agrees with (1) here because the principal opens $D(g)\cong\operatorname{Spec}A_g$ form a basis of $\operatorname{Spec}A$, smoothness of morphisms is local on the source (Morphisms, Lemma 01V6), and $\operatorname{Spec}A_g\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ is smooth in the sense of [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] iff $R\to A_g$ is a smooth ring map (Morphisms, Lemma 01V6 (1)$\Leftrightarrow$(2) together with More on Morphisms, Lemma 02H6); a split of this node has to carry that identification.)

proof.text: Construct the equivalence by applying the forward implication to a smooth neighbourhood and the reverse implication to the lifting hypothesis.
